Organization]] during the first [[Banlands]] cutscene}} }} ==Description== The '''Narrator''' is the main antagonist and narrator of the [[Lunar Overture Event]] and [[The Final Act Event]], as well as a main character later turned antagonist present in the [[Null & Void Event]]. He also appears as the narrator of the [[Halloween 2020 Event]], serving as a self described artist and performer, he is also the owner of his "''Solar Theatres''", a production group that the [[T.D.S. Organization]] was invited or brought by some other method to watch prior to the beginning of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. He is a servant of [[Lord Exo]], which based on his [[Banlands]] dialogue{{InlineQuote|I've been beside [[Lord Exo]] long before you came into your worthless existence!|'''Narrator''' on Wave 22 ([[Banlands]])}}
{{InlineQuote|Seriously! He's been like that since the [[Old World]].|'''Narrator''' on Wave 7 ([[Banlands]])}}, he appears to have become one in the [[Old World]]. The '''Narrator''' also is in control of a set of hands, given to him by [[Lord Exo]]{{InlineQuote|I've been beside [[Lord Exo]] long before you came into your worthless existence! (...) He even gave me my beloved hands. Isn't that right, [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]]?|'''Narrator''' on Wave 22 ([[Banlands]])}}, similarly likely during the [[Old World]]. These hands are named [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]]. While obedient to the '''Narrator''', they have their own mind allowing them to act by themselves and giving them distinct personalities[[File:LeftyRightyPersonalitiesProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/587355301674614854/1460645055101665340 (Tower Defense Simulator Server), though their actions are still generally done to benefit the '''Narrator'''. ==Personality== The '''Narrator''' is shown to be quick to anger. He can easily start attacking people if they made him mad, either verbally by shouting at them or physically with [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]]. The '''Narrator''' is very passionate about his shows. He has been shown to get mad for his shown being ruined in the [[Null & Void Event]]'s second night and in the third night's final cutscene, he tries to convince [[Lord Exo]] to watch his show. Despite caring a great deal about his show, he does not seem to hold the same regard about his actors. These actors all appear to be working for him not because they want to, but because they are forced to based on many enemy [[Logbooks]].{{InlineQuote|The Attendee is a controlled resident from the overtaken base Under the Narrator's spell, they are forced to join and help the theater grow. The mask hides their struggling expression as the spell physically controls their body rather than brainwashing their mind.|[[Attendee]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} In the [[The Great Finale]], the [[Executioner (Lunar Overture)|Executioner]] actor suggested a pay raise, but the '''Narrator''' laughed at him and said no.From non-canon material. The '''Narrator''' also refers to his actors as disposable on several occasions, which is best demonstrated when he turns one of his actors into a frog as punishment in [[The Final Act Event]]. The '''Narrator''' has also been shown to break the fourth on multiple occasions, either by talking to the player themselves or by referencing in-game mechanics like cutscenes or waves. Not much can be said about the '''Narrator's''' character from his initial appearance in the [[Halloween 2020 Event]], as his personality was more built upon years later. In the event dialogue, he is seen to be a mysterious and knowledgeable figure, sometimes helping the player with his tips. ==Abilities & Characteristics== {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" ! colspan="2" |'''Abilities''' |- |'''Levitation''': Having no feet, the '''Narrator''' traverses the ground by levitating. The highest he has been shown to levitate was a few meters above the ground, however, he is regularly shown only just above it. |[[File:Narratorlevitates.JPG|200px|center|thumb|The '''Narrator''' levitates above the ground.]] |- |'''Magic''': While he does not use magic often, the '''Narrator''' can be inferred to be a proficient sorcerer, given how he effortlessly transformed one of his extras into a frog in the beginning cutscene of [[The Narratorium]], and how he placed innumerable military personnel under his spell to be part of his show. |[[File:NarratorFrogPower.gif|200px|center|thumb|"''Aw man! Not again!''"]] |- | colspan="2" |'''Possession''': The '''Narrator''' is able to possess the [[Spectator|Spectators]] to use as vessels for his form.{{InlineQuote|[[Right Hand|Righty]] finds the [[Spectator]]s unsettling because when they were possessed by the '''Narrator''', their bodies transformed into coal-black silhouettes.|[[Spectator]]'s description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]].}} It is unknown if he had possessed anything other than a [[Spectator]]. |- |'''Mimicry''': The '''Narrator''' is able to mimic voices that belong to other people. He has first been shown to do this in [[The Final Act Event]], mimicking [[Lord Exo]]'s voice. |[[File:TheFinalActWave7-2.ogg|300px]] |- ! colspan="2" |'''Other''' |- |'''Puppet Hands''': The '''Narrator''' was shown to telepathically control a set of puppet hands named [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]], that he can use for offensive and transportational purposes. With the hands, he has been shown killing/attacking [[Penumbras]] and [[Titus]], and using them to lift himself into the air. |[[File:Narratorliftshimself1.png|200px|center|thumb|The '''Narrator''' lifts himself into the air.]] |} ==Story== ===Old World=== The '''Narrator''' becomes [[Lord Exo]]'s servant and right-hand man. At some point, he is given [[Left Hand|Lefty]] and [[Right Hand|Righty]] as a gift from [[Lord Exo]]. ===Halloween 2020=== The '''Narrator''' is present for [[Lord Sinister]]'s attack on [[Trick or Threat Town]], hiding with a [[God Cube]] fragment with him. It is unknown whether he had revealed himself to the [[T.D.S. Organization]] at this time, and whether the map's dialogue was his way of doing so. After the attack has been stopped and the town's citizens are abandoning it, three brothers, [[Kronus]], [[Ramiel]] and [[Marcellus]] find him with a shard next to him. He promises them that [[Lord Exo]] will bring back the town to its former glory.{{InlineQuote|As the brothers left, [[Kronus]] found a [[God Cube|God]] Shard that was left behind, along with '''Narrator'''. That’s when '''Narrator''' promised that [[Lord Exo]] would rebuild the town, and the brothers could live together once more.|[[Kronus]]' description in his [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} ===Between Halloween 2020 – Lunar Overture=== The '''Narrator''' leads the [[Children of Exo]] to the Temple of Exo. Afterwards, he agrees to help them rebuild the [[God Cube]].{{InlineQuote|You USED me, to bring you to the Temple of Exo! THEN you scheming JERKS made me put together your [[God Cube|GOD CUBE]] PIECES before throwing me to the Executioner!|'''Narrator''' to [[Titus]] in the first [[Banlands]] cutscene}} ===Lunar Overture=== The '''Narrator''' unveils his grand show to the [[T.D.S. Organization]]. In the first act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]], [[A Dark Tale]], the '''Narrator''' shows T.D.S. a retelling of [[The Umbra]]'s origin, and how she came into contact with the [[God Cube]]. The same thing happens in the second act, [[The Haunted Past]], except this time it is a retelling of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]] and the [[Halloween 2020 Event]], where it is revealed that the [[Jack O' Bot]] and [[Lord Sinister]] were sent by [[The Umbra]] to retrieve [[God Cube]] fragments from [[Nightmare Carnival]] and [[Trick or Threat Town]]. Things get complicated with the third act of the performance, [[The Great Finale]], as elements of it have been de-canonized.[[File:Act3NonCanonProof.png|280px]]
https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1930307110408987121 But according to the [[Logbooks]] of [[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]], [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2]], [[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]] and the [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]], the third act did occur, but a "''glitch''" rewound time to before it even happened, and all the memories of the event happening began to fade away from those who participated in it.{{InlineQuote|Then, a "glitch" offered an unexpected opportunity. Time had slowed to a crawl and, in an instant, reversed to a moment before the supposed grand finale. They believed the show was finished, but moments later, their memories began to fade away.|[[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]] description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} Interestingly, the "''glitch''" not only caused a temporal shift, but a spatial one, as well. *The [[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]] [[Logbooks|Logbook]] states that the actor was warped to the [[The Haunted Past|Act 2]] set.{{InlineQuote|Eventually, their daydream snapped to reality—sitting on a Ferris Wheel, overlooking the wooden bridges.|[[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]] description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} *The [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]] [[Logbooks|Logbook]] states that its actor was warped to the [[Old World|Nil Zone]].{{InlineQuote|When the world went blank, the mechanical rot was cast into the [[Old World|Nil Zone]].|[[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]] description in its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]}} *The '''Narrator''' also appears in the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]] during the [[Null & Void Event]], though as he is also stated to have done things outside of it, is it unclear if he was actually sent there during the "''glitch''" or not. The culprit behind the glitch is the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]], who decided to intervene by rewriting history, leading to the event being removed from reality.[[File:Act3RewriteProof.png|280px]]
https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/2022808259971666007 ===Between Operation I.C.E. – Ducky Revenge=== Some time after the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], the '''Narrator''' plants a [[God Cube]] fragment inside the toilet of the [[Duck Realm]].{{InlineQuote|Once [[Ramiel]] used the card and messed up their portals, I hid a shard in their toilet!|'''Narrator''' on Wave 9 ([[Blind Faith]])}} ===Null & Void=== The '''Narrator''', alongside his hands, is now stranded in the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]], either banished there by the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] or through his own volition. There he meets various characters, first being [[Titus]] being carried by the [[Null Guardian]], who the '''Narrator''' attacks as he believes the [[Children of Exo]] used him for their own gain then left him to die. Later, he also finds out multiple [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents were sent there. Shocked to see them there he similarly starts attacking them, this time for ruining his show. He is interrupted by by [[Titus]], which leads to the '''Narrator''' slapping him away. He then introduces them to the [[Banlands|Outer Nil Zone]] and tells them who the [[Null Guardian]] is. Shortly after, both the [[T.D.S. Organization]] agents and '''Narrator''' find out that the [[Null Guardian]] is going to execute them, leading to a temporary alliance between the two. After the [[Null Guardian]] is killed, a failsafe in his body activates and sends them over directly where the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] currently is, that is fighting the [[Children of Exo]] to gain their half of the [[God Cube]]. Seeing an opportunity to free [[Lord Exo]], he ends the alliance with the [[T.D.S. Organization]] by grabbing the [[Rift Walker (Story)|Rift Walker]] with [[Right Hand|Righty]]. Afterwards, he continues to keep him restrained until he is corrupted and possessed by [[Lord Exo]]. He is also fully present for [[Lord Exo]] deciding to take over [[Kronus]]' body, though he does not intervene. Instead, after he finds an appropriate body and does everything he wanted, he invites him to his newest premiere. This invitation is declined, as [[Lord Exo]] no longer sees any use in him. Disappointed, he leaves and instead invites the [[T.D.S. Organization]] to it. ===The Final Act=== The '''Narrator''' overtakes an unspecified military base, transforming it into his stage and cursing its personnel to be a part of his show. He sends an invitation to the [[T.D.S. Organization]], and after consideration from the [[Commander]], he leads a team consisting of the [[Engineer]], [[Freezer]], [[Scout]], [[Mortar]] and himself to [[The Narratorium]] where they investigate his activities. The '''Narrator's''' show retells [[Lord Exo]] and [[Two X]]'s origin within the [[Old World]], and how the two brothers came into conflict with each other, resulting in the war that resulted in [[Lord Exo]]'s imprisonment, the destruction of the [[Old World]], and the creation of The Meta. At the end of the show, when the '''Narrator''' is defeated, his hands begin violently shaking and later deflate, something he claims is [[Lord Exo]] killing them. After this, he strikes up a deal with the [[Commander]], promising to take him to [[Lord Exo]] in exchange for something not revealed to the player. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} ActIIIUpdateIcon.png|The '''Narrator's''' puppet hand seen on the game icon.
